title: 9 Best Tolerated Iron Supplements for Gentle Absorption - caelusgreenroom
abstract:
### Pros  
- **High bioavailability**– chelated bisglycinate is absorbed better than ferrous sulfate.
- **Gentle on the gut**– formulated to avoid constipation and stomach upset.
- **Sport‑safe**– NSF Certified for Sport ensures no banned substances.
#### Formulation and Iron Type  
Iron comes primarily as ferrous sulfate, gluconate, fumarate, or bisglycinate; each varies in elemental iron percentage and gastrointestinal tolerance.  
Bisglycinate and gluconate are often gentler, while sulfate provides higher iron per dose but may cause constipation. Choose a formulation that aligns with your absorption needs and comfort level during supplementation.
## Frequently Asked Questions  
### What makes an iron supplement gentle on the stomach?  
Use ferrous bisglycinate or iron polysaccharide; they irritate less.
